reconfigure.title: Change Nord Pool source
reconfigure.description: Only the Nord Pool configuration and market area can be changed, and only while shadow mode is enabled. To change the sensor or heater, use the integration options.

user.title: Add a price-aware thermostat
user.description: Choose a control type and an external temperature sensor. New entries start in shadow mode, which calculates decisions without sending any commands. The heat pump/AC type commands an existing climate entity from the room sensor once live control is confirmed.

invalid_price_source.title: The selected Nord Pool source needs attention
invalid_price_source.description: The selected Nord Pool configuration was removed or no longer provides the configured market area. Check the official Nord Pool integration under Settings → Devices & services. Then enable shadow mode in this thermostat’s options and use Reconfigure to select an existing Nord Pool configuration and one of its areas. Existing cached prices can remain in use until they expire; without usable prices the thermostat uses its base target. This issue clears on the next price refresh after the source is corrected. Do not change physical device ownership to fix a price source.
